title: Employment Situation (Oct 2027 data) — 08:30 ET, the first payroll after the October FOMC and the release that closes the September SEP meeting's two-print window
source: EST: derived from BLS's own published scheduling rule — release on the third Friday following the end of the reference week (the Sun-Sat week containing the 12th) — using the implementation jobs-2027-10-08's own initial research re-wrote and re-validated from scratch on 2026-09-09, 7 for 7 against the four confirmed jobs-* entries on this calendar (2026-09-04, 2026-10-02, 2026-11-06, 2026-12-04) and the three historical Sunday-July-4 releases (2004-07-02, 2010-07-02, 2021-07-02). October 2027's 12th is a TUESDAY, so the reference week is Sun 2027-10-10 to Sat 2027-10-16 and the third Friday after 10-16 is 2027-11-05 — an ordinary first-Friday release, and an ordinary NYSE trading day with no holiday anywhere near the rule's own Friday. The prefix is EST: and not BLS: because bls.gov returned HTTP 403 on all four schedule routes re-tried on 2026-09-09 and fred.stlouisfed.org/release/dates?rid=50 returned HTTP 404 — recorded in jobs-2027-10-08's probe-ref.blocked. A derived date is not a published one. Discovered 2026-09-09 during the never-assessed initial research of jobs-2027-10-08
notes: PROPOSED BY jobs-2027-10-08's initial research (2026-09-09) at D+28 — outside the 5-day corridor, and proposed anyway for the same reason its own proposer was: it is the fact that makes the proposer's structural leg checkable. jobs-2027-10-08 claims to be the ONLY payroll the 2027-10-26/27 FOMC sees; that claim is unfalsifiable unless the next release is on the calendar and lands after the meeting, which 2027-11-05 does by 9 days. THREE THINGS A LATER LANE SHOULD NOT HAVE TO REDISCOVER. (1) THIS ONE IS THE ORDINARY SHAPE, AND ITS PROPOSER WAS NOT. jobs-2027-10-08 is a second-Friday release (8.1% of releases 1993-2027) leaving 5 trading sessions to the same-month opex; 2027-11-05 is a first-Friday release leaving 10 sessions to opex on 2027-11-19. Nothing about the runway finding transfers — it is a property of the second-Friday configuration, not of payrolls. (2) ITS SEASONAL PROFILE IS UNTESTED HERE AND THE THREE MEASURED MONTHS DISAGREE VIOLENTLY. jobs-2027-08-06 measured August as bond-dominated (TLT/IEF/AGG amplification ranks 1/1/1), jobs-2027-09-03 measured September as quiet everywhere (SPY 11/12, QQQ 12/12), and jobs-2027-10-08 measured October as equity-side with rates dead last (QQQ 4/12, IEF and AGG both 12/12). November was measured by none of the three and must not be assumed to resemble any of them. (3) ITS CORRIDOR CARRIES A SECOND BOND-ONLY CLOSURE. Veterans Day 2027 falls on Thursday 2027-11-11, a SIFMA-recommended fixed-income close with NYSE open — the same asymmetric structure jobs-2027-10-08 found at its own D+3 and measured to a null for duration amplification. That date is NOT proposed here: no SIFMA or Fed holiday page was fetched by this session and a fabricated date is worse than a recorded hole. HONEST LIMITS. Filed status estimate and it must stay there until bls.gov's 2027 schedule is retrievable; this lane never self-confirms an event it discovered in-sweep, and the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a derived date. impact high and symbols [] match every other jobs-* entry. Estimates widen caution and license no entry.
